name: Quantum Mechanics I
description: Historical foundations of quantum theory, de Broglie waves, Schrödinger equation, wave functions as quantum states, wave-particle duality, probabilistic/statistical interpretation, superposition principle, expectation values, uncertainty relations, postulates of quantum mechanics, quantum measurement, Born rule, one-dimensional examples, potential wells, tunneling, Dirac bra-ket formalism, state vectors, harmonic oscillator, ladder operators, operators and their representations, angular momentum, spherically symmetric potentials, hydrogen atom, spin, addition of angular momenta, many-particle systems, composite systems, entanglement, EPR paradox, Bell's inequality, decoherence, interpretations of quantum mechanics.
